title: 第5章 察觉端倪第6章 莲公主
slug: 长生从守书阁的太监开始
lines: 李叶青坐在连廊下，回味着方才赵公公的叮嘱，有一种心惊肉跳的感觉。
金石医药，无论是哪一个，深宫中的妃子涉及，大概都不是什么好事
而自己，很有可能是唯一知情的那一个。
不对，现在有了第二个了。
怪不得赵公公会说还算我老实，要是我帮忙遮掩，他就会表示自己也知道，那长春宫若是想遮掩事情，就不能对我下手，不然的话书阁之中的两个太监同时身死，也太可疑了。
可若是我照实说，赵公公就会认为我跟他不是一条心，自然就坐视长春宫作为
深宫啊，吃人的。
一时间只觉得心绪万千没无法平静，即便是手捧书本，却怎么也看不进去。
无奈之下只能将《清静经》拿出来诵读一遍，才压下心中的烦乱，将注意力重新投放到医书之中。
就在这时，一直躺在门廊下的赵公公，不知何时睁开了眼睛，浑浊的目光落在专注的李叶青身上。
“倒是个读书的好苗子，可惜投错了胎，做了太监”
书阁中的两个人查阅书籍一直到了午后，青鸾才带着小宫女走出书阁，脸上带着浅浅的微笑，显然是查到了自己想要的东西。
这时候赵公公也悠悠醒转。
“哦，早上贵人到来，老朽未曾迎接，实在是失礼。”
青鸾见状也是善解人意的一笑。
“赵公公说笑了，哪敢劳动您的大架，况且这位李公公刚才已经帮我找到了所要的书籍，我这里谢你们还来不及呢！”
“不敢当不敢当，能为端妃娘娘排忧解难，是我们这些奴才的荣幸，以后但有相关要求，我们必定全力配合。”
赵公公这话也是说的不显山不露水，却让青鸾脸色一变，很快又恢复微笑。
他就是在暗示长春宫寻找金石医药之书的事情他也已经知晓，不要想着动歪心思。
“一定一定。”
随即带着身后的小宫女就离开了。
李叶青这时候才抬起头，用望气术看着青鸾头顶的气。
淡淡的青气缭绕，代表着这个人气运不错，大概率有个一官半职，这倒也不错，宫里女官的地位可一点都不低。
只是这淡淡的青气之中却有一点红色，好似那烈火烹油、鲜花似锦的繁盛，却暗藏**的气息。
这个时候，背对着他的青鸾心中似有所感，突然转身，两个人四目相对的一瞬间，青鸾眉头微蹙，李叶青则是赶忙低下头，做出一副恭顺姿态。
青鸾离去后，书阁重归寂静，只剩下窗外偶尔的鸟鸣和赵公公悠长的呼吸声。
但李叶青的心却无法平静，他回到东侧第二排书架，顺着书籍摆放的顺序，找到了青鸾所寻找的那本书。
《金丹录》
随即翻开，开始仔细地研读起来。
经历了今天的事情，李叶青知道，这皇城是一座巨大的漩涡，无处可以幸免，连书阁也不能。
而他的解析系统，以及日益增长的知识，将成为他在这深宫旋涡中安身立命的最大依仗。
他必须要利用好这个依仗，增加自己的优势。
而通过阅读对方读过的医药书籍，了解对方的目的，就让他有了料敌于先的底气。
在旧书中寻找对方阅读的痕迹，停留的位置并不难。
这里的书籍大都已经十年二十年未曾被人翻开，而今天被人翻开，就会留下明显的痕迹。
content_en:
Li Yeqing sat under the corridor, recalling Eunuch Zhao's instructions just now, and felt a trepidation in his heart.
Jinshi Medicine, no matter which one it is, it is probably not a good thing to involve a concubine in the palace.
And he is probably the only one who knows.
No, there's a second one now.
No wonder Eunuch Zhao said that I was honest. If I helped cover it up, he would say that he knew it too. If the Changchun Palace wanted to cover up the matter, it couldn't do anything to me. Otherwise, it would be too suspicious if the two eunuchs in the library died at the same time.
But if I tell the truth, Eunuch Zhao will think that he and I are not of the same mind, and he will naturally sit back and watch what Changchun Palace does.
Deep palace, cannibals.
For a moment, I felt that my mind was filled with so many emotions that I couldn't calm down. Even though I was holding a book in my hand, I couldn't read it.
In desperation, I could only take out the "Qing Jing Sutra" and recite it once before suppressing the annoyance in my heart and returning my attention to the medical book.
At this moment, Eunuch Zhao, who had been lying under the porch, opened his eyes at some point, and his turbid eyes fell on the focused Li Yeqing.
"He was a good scholar, but unfortunately he was born into the wrong child and became a eunuch."
The two people in the bookstore checked the books until the afternoon. Qingluan took the little palace maid out of the bookstore with a slight smile on his face, obviously he had found what he wanted.
At this time, Eunuch Zhao also woke up leisurely.
"Oh, it's really rude that I didn't greet the noble lady when she arrived this morning."
Qingluan also smiled considerately when he saw this.
"Eunuch Zhao is joking, how can I dare to use your arrogance? Besides, Eunuch Li has just helped me find the books I want. It's not too late for me to thank you!"
"Don't take it seriously. It's an honor for us slaves to be able to solve the problems for Concubine Duan. In the future, if there are relevant requests, we will fully cooperate."
Eunuch Zhao's words were also said in a subtle way, but Qingluan's expression changed and he soon returned to smiling.
He was just hinting that he already knew about Changchun Palace's search for the Book of Inscriptions, Stones and Medicine, so he shouldn't think about it wrongly.
"Definitely."
Then he left with the little palace maid behind him.
Only then did Li Yeqing raise his head and use his Qi-gazing technique to look at the Qi above Qingluan's head.
A faint green aura lingers, which means that this person is very lucky, and there is a high probability that he will have an official position, which is not bad. The status of a female official in the palace is not low at all.
But there is a bit of red in this faint green air, just like the burning oil and the prosperity of flowers, but there is a hidden aura of lust.
At this time, Qingluan, who had his back turned to him, seemed to feel something in his heart, and suddenly turned around. The moment the two people's eyes met, Qingluan frowned slightly, while Li Yeqing hurriedly lowered his head, making a respectful gesture.
After Qingluan left, the bookstore returned to silence, with only the occasional birdsong outside the window and Eunuch Zhao's long breathing.
But Li Yeqing's heart could not calm down. He returned to the second row of bookshelves on the east side, followed the order of the books, and found the book Qingluan was looking for.
"Golden Pill Record"
Then he opened it and began to study it carefully.
After what happened today, Li Yeqing knew that this imperial city was a huge whirlpool, and no one was immune, not even the bookstore.
And his analytical system and his growing knowledge will become his greatest reliance in settling down in this deep palace vortex.
He must make good use of this support to increase his advantage.
And by reading the medical books the other party has read and understanding the other party's purpose, he has the confidence to predict the enemy first.
It is not difficult to find traces of the other person’s reading and where they stayed in old books.
Most of the books here have not been opened for ten or twenty years, but if they are opened today, they will leave obvious traces.
